current: The fail-closed core exists for the capital envelope: Cell::intent_for checks the envelope against the cell's own clock on every use and refuses every new intent for that strategy once it has expired, under the envelope_expiry gate (cell.rs:3493-3497; the desk's legs at :5912-5928). The cell resumes only when a fresh, verified envelope arrives through Cell::renew_capital. Expiry does not set Cell::is_halted(), which reads only the kill switch, the policy halt and the polled halt (cell.rs:1956). So it does not trigger the mass cancel that withdraw_expired runs only for a halted cell (cell.rs:4139-4142), and it does not move qip_edge_halted. Policy-payload staleness never halts by design: DegradationState::halts() is const false, 'halting belongs to the kill switch'.
